capabilities: Generate test questions from selected notes using LLM providers
Grade answers against original note content with instant feedback
Manage all tests from a dashboard
Mark multiple completed tests in bulk
extras: Privacy note: selected notes' content is sent to the chosen LLM provider; the README links each provider's privacy policy. Question types are fixed (1-, 2-, and 3-mark questions); customization may come later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into graded knowledge tests, so reviewing material means leaving the vault or writing questions by hand.

relations.evidence: Uses LLM APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google, and DeepSeek for test generation and grading
Select your preferred LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Mistral, Gemini, or DeepSeek)
multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Gemini, DeepSeek)
Google Gemini: Get your API key from Google AI Studio
DeepSeek: Get your API key from the DeepSeek website
Ollama: No API key required. Download and install Ollama from Ollama.com and run the models locally

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google Gemini, or DeepSeek API key

summary: LLM-powered quiz generator that creates test questions from selected notes, grades answers with feedback, and tracks scores in a dashboard.
